verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for an online notarization and incorporation service with a web portal and API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, cookie consent, or any tracking opt-out control. The docs cover only notarization, incorporation, translation, tax-registration endpoints and webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
